about: UI fixture for the M3 Unblock end-to-end suites (hub/test/e2e/unblock.spec.mjs, accessibility.spec.mjs, security.spec.mjs), on top of the control harness of control.spec.mjs and its repos (hub/test/fixtures/ui/control.json). Every path uses the /home/you placeholder, which the harness replaces with a temporary HOME. `sessions.pty` are the two PTY sessions, spawned through deckd as `fm claude` does, each running a fake claude script (a name under hub/test/fixtures/scripts or inline steps); the Destructive one draws its prompt on the SYNTHETIC 2.1.285 bash frame (D-95). `sessions.observed` is a plain claude session fed through the hooks socket, with a Caution request and a question it cannot answer from the deck. `promptBar` names the extra PTY sessions the PromptBar audit needs for the Caution and question tiers. `ruleOffers` are two rule offers as the snapshot carries them (the second with ruleNote anyFlags, which no shipped tiers entry carries since D-103, so a test injects it). `rules5` is three repos holding five rules in their .claude/settings.local.json. `settingsLocal` is the settings file exit criterion 3 writes into: its keys and their order must survive a rule write and its Undo. `xss` holds the qa 1.7 payloads the security suite puts in an option label, a rule pattern and diff text.
